_comment: UC-1 step 3 — the POST /sessions body the launcher sends (LAUNCH-ADMIT-LAUNCHER). Shape: gateway sessions.schema.json #/post/input. No model, no chain, no deny list, no key ref (LAUNCH-ADMIT-NO-MODEL). The bind names the pod step 5 creates: namespace = the repo, the worker ServiceAccount, the (task, round) pod name. Note the supplier's own UC-1 bind-request.json uses task `homelab-2588-r1` and namespace `platform-agents` — values this launcher never sends.
